title: AlexNet won by 10 points and ended an era overnight
body: In 2012 AlexNet, a deep convolutional network trained on two gaming GPUs, won ImageNet with 15.3 percent top-5 error against 26.2 for the best hand-engineered pipeline. A decade of feature craftsmanship was outclassed in one result. Krizhevsky, Sutskever and Hinton's paper is the usual marker for deep learning's industrial takeover.
